Name: Sweet Cherry's Indoor Soil Plots
Author: sweetcherrypopxo
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Flat Indoor Soil lets you place simple soil patches indoors and grow crops without using garden pots!!

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Download and unzip the mod, then place both included folders into your Stardew Valley mods folder. Launch the game through SMAPI!

[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]Adds flat, plantable soil for indoor areas[/*]
[*]Sold at Pierre’s shop for 50g[/*]
[*]Craftable using 1 Clay and 3 Stone[/*]
[*]Works like normal tilled soil[/*]
[*]Supports planting and growing crops indoors[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and the developers of SMAPI and Content Patcher for making mods like this possible!!

Manifest.Name: Flat Indoor Soil
Manifest.Description: Adds flat placeable indoor soil tiles for planting without garden pots.
